technique_name: How might organizations use SaaS (Software as a Service) to reduce costs?
description: Organizations can use SaaS (Software as a Service) to reduce costs by eliminating the need to purchase hardware and software licenses. SaaS allows businesses to access and use software applications remotely on a subscription or pay-per-use basis, rather than purchasing and installing software on each device. Additionally, SaaS offers advantages such as scalability, cost savings on infrastructure, easily upgradable and customizable solutions, better customer service and faster customer onboarding
